name: Hongou
source: The tour guide. He looks a little dark-eyed, but he's very humble and always attentive to his customers. He has a strong sense of responsibility. During the tour, he's always on the move for everyone. Since he was a student he loved to travel and finally got a job and he was hooked.  His family owns a cake shop, which is run by his younger brother.
